name: Turkey Larb Lettuce Wraps
description: Thai-style ground turkey with lime, fish sauce, ginger, and fresh herbs, spooned into lettuce cups.

recipeInstructions.text: Toast jasmine rice in a dry skillet over medium, shaking the pan, until deep golden, 5 minutes. Grind it coarsely in a spice grinder or mortar and set aside.
Whisk together fish sauce, the juice of limes, honey, and red pepper flakes.
Heat neutral oil in the skillet over medium-high. Add ground turkey and cook, breaking it into small crumbles, until no longer pink, 5-6 minutes.
Add shallots, ginger, and garlic. Cook until the shallots soften, 2 minutes. Take the pan off the heat.

Pour in the dressing and toss. Let it cool a couple of minutes, then fold in cilantro, mint, scallions, and the toasted rice powder. Taste: it should be sour, salty, and a little spicy. Add more lime or fish sauce to get there.
Spoon into leaves of butter lettuce and serve with steamed jasmine rice.
For leftovers, store the turkey apart from the lettuce and herbs. It's good cold or warm over rice for lunch. Keeps 3 days.
